library.pt_120:r_0aee85115ccb7e1a.text:
An astrophysicist working for the Earth Federation's space agency.
Her ancestor was the genetic donor for Nena Trinity, so she bears a striking resemblance to her.
Their personalities are similar too - she speaks cheerfully and sometimes acts flippant or teasing, but she is an excellent scientist.
She is acquainted with $$ビリー$$ and has carried a fondness for him for some time.

library.pt_120:r_d1821cf899579a4a.text:
A young man working in space development. 24 years old.
He majored in aerospace engineering as a student, and was $$刹那$$'s next-door neighbor at their apartment while $$刹那$$ was undercover.
His parents had already passed away. His older sister was also killed after becoming involved with the Gundams, leaving him with no family left, and his girlfriend $$ルイス$$ left him after she too was caught up in a Gundam attack.
Even so, he took the job in space development he had dreamed of, but was suspected of being a Katharon operative and detained. $$刹那$$ and the others rescued him there, and he began acting alongside them.
At first he harbored resentment toward Celestial Being, the organization that had cost him his family and $$ルイス$$, but on learning that $$ルイス$$ was among the $$アロウズ$$ pilots, he resolved to stand on the battlefield in order to win her back.
His feelings against fighting never changed, but he came to believe that he should 'still do what he can do now,' and boarded the O Raiser. He fought in his own way while supporting $$刹那$$.
In the final battle, the Trans-Am Burst triggered by the $$ダブルオーライザー$$ let him share consciousness with $$ルイス$$. After a desperate appeal, he succeeded in bringing her back.
He has since left Celestial Being, and now works in the space elevator industry while caring for $$ルイス$$, who still suffers aftereffects.

library.pt_120:r_0ddd71c78c10284f.text:
A former $$アロウズ$$ pilot. 24 years old.
She once lived in a world untouched by conflict, an exchange student from Spain living in Japan, and she and $$沙慈$$ made a well-matched couple.
But when Nena's whim cost her her parents, many relatives, and her own left hand, she broke with $$沙慈$$ and chose the path of revenge against the Gundams.
Born into a wealthy family, she funded $$アロウズ$$ with the large inheritance she received. Though her rank was only ensign, she enjoyed generous treatment from the higher-ups in various ways, from having her opinions heard to being issued new-model machines.
Her experience as a soldier was shallow and her lack of skill undeniable, and she suffered from cellular damage caused by past exposure to GN particles from a quasi-solar furnace, requiring her to take sedatives. Despite these problems, she threw herself into battle carrying her hatred of the Gundams.
Ribbons took advantage of this, using her as a test subject to awaken artificial Innovators by continually administering her nanomachines in the form of a sedative. As a result, her body came to require regular sedative doses.
When she confronted $$沙慈$$ in person during the final battle, hatred and rage drove her into a deranged state, but the Trans-Am Burst let her and $$沙慈$$ understand each other, and she regained her sanity. The cellular damage that had been eating away at her body was also removed by the power of GN particles.
However, she has yet to overcome the aftereffects of the nanomachines Ribbons administered to her and the PTSD from the war. Even two years after the war's end, she remains hospitalized, cared for by $$沙慈$$.

library.pt_120:r_b8ee157ce285cf0d.text:
First princess of the Kingdom of Azadistan. 31 years old.
She was raised as an ordinary citizen, but was placed at the head of the restored monarchy in order to rebuild her country's economy after its oil resources ran dry.
As a national leader, her will to reform her troubled country is strong, but her lack of experience as a leader made her a target of criticism from reformists and hatred from conservatives alike.
She met $$刹那$$ after being caught up in the fighting, and though both of them wished for peace, differences in how they chose to live kept pulling them apart.
Her association with Celestial Being led to her being suspected and detained for a time, but she was rescued by $$刹那$$ and the others, together with $$アレルヤ$$.
However, her homeland was devastated by Saachez and placed under Federation control, and from then on she acted together with Katharon.
As the fighting spread, she searched for a path other than fighting, and wrote a song with a group of children to bring her wish for peace to the world. The song spread across the globe and became a driving force for peace.
After the war she returned as princess of a rebuilt Azadistan, and now works to reverse the policies the Earth Federation government pursued during the war.

library.pt_120:r_bb8fc3c736f4cca6.text:
Formerly $$マリナ$$'s close aide. 34 years old.
Strong-willed and intelligent, she possessed the insight to support $$マリナ$$ as head of Azadistan, and had an extremely broad knowledge of world affairs and the various factions.
After the Federation government was established, she parted ways with the pacifist $$マリナ$$ and joined Katharon's Middle East branch. As $$クラウス$$'s partner, she began working tirelessly not only for her homeland Azadistan but for the whole world.
After the war with the Innovades, she serves as a representative of the reborn Earth Federation alongside $$クラウス$$.

library.pt_120:r_1e1f299a3e781af6.text:
A representative of the Earth Federation. 31 years old.
He originally served as leader of Katharon's Middle East branch, a rational man with strong leadership. He viewed $$アロウズ$$' atrocities as a threat and hoped to build an ordered, peaceful society.
Even after $$アロウズ$$ destroyed his base and forced him to flee, his resolve never broke, and he continued his activities together with his comrade $$シーリン$$, protecting $$マリナ$$.
During the final battle against the Innovades, he led Katharon's remaining forces and saved Celestial Being from crisis.

library.pt_120:r_72560b5c2ff2c6fb.text:
President of the Earth Federation government.
The representative of the newly restarted Earth Federation government, which now includes former non-member nations and anti-Federation organizations.
He rejects $$アロウズ$$' methods and is trying to achieve lasting peace by prioritizing conciliatory policy over the use of force.

library.pt_120:r_e5bf87194998f017.text:
A Gundam Meister appearing in the in-story film 'Celestial Being.'
An Asian young man with a scar over his left eye who plays the role based on $$刹那$$, though his personality and everything else about him bears no resemblance.
He rides the $$ダブルオーライザー$$, and in the decisive battle against $$アロウズ$$, gathered the power of four Trans-Ams into one and unleashed the Raiser Sword.

library.pt_120:r_819d0aa9d8831607.text:
A Gundam Meister appearing in the in-story film 'Celestial Being.'
A bespectacled young man who pilots the Cherudim Gundam.

library.pt_120:r_51dff9d23924ed59.text:
A Gundam Meister appearing in the in-story film 'Celestial Being.'
The lone woman on the team, piloting the Arios Gundam; she bears no resemblance whatsoever to $$アレルヤ$$, the machine's original pilot.

library.pt_120:r_887bcda2cda677f2.text:
A Gundam Meister appearing in the in-story film 'Celestial Being.'
A well-built black man who pilots the Seravee Gundam, with a distinctive regional accent.
He trapped the Alvaaron inside a cross of light, sealing its movements.

library.pt_120:r_4cb7c77cdb8fc250.text:
Head of the Corner family, which wields great influence in world politics and finance. 36 years old.
He has two faces: his public role as Union ambassador to the $$ＵＮ$$, and his hidden role as an observer of Celestial Being.
He used his position to secretly plot the Corner family's domination of the world. Together with Ribbons, he seized control of $$ヴェーダ$$, and murdered Aeolia while he lay in cryogenic sleep.
As the final step, he boarded the giant mobile armor Alvatore intending to wipe out Celestial Being, but was defeated by $$刹那$$'s Exia. On learning that he himself had been dancing in the palm of Ribbons's hand all along, he died in shock and fury.
In the in-story film 'Celestial Being,' he appears in the role of the villainous leader, riding a maned Alvaaron to scatter an anti-Federation organization, only to be struck down by Celestial Being's sudden attack.

library.pt_120:r_e06a9f9888ae1cc4.text:
The pilot of the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$. 16 years old.
He grew up without knowing his father's face, but after his mother's death, his estranged father arranged for him to attend the Anaheim Electronics technical college on the space colony Industrial 7.
When he saved $$オードリー$$ after she fell from the colony sky, he was drawn into the conflict over 'Laplace's Box.' During the fighting on Industrial 7, he boarded the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, entrusted to him by $$カーディアス・ビスト$$, and from then on found himself, as if guided, fighting his way across the world.
Because he is a civilian, he is not bound by any faction's ideology, and he alone in the midst of the war has the strength to voice a purely human opinion, along with a gentleness that makes him care for others.

library.pt_120:r_ffc5236c61fe4b9d.text:
The pilot of the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$. 16 years old.
He grew up without knowing his father's face, but after his mother's death, his estranged father arranged for him to attend the Anaheim Electronics technical college on the space colony Industrial 7.
When he saved $$オードリー$$ after she fell from the colony sky, he was drawn into the conflict over 'Laplace's Box.' During the fighting on Industrial 7, he boarded the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, entrusted to him by his father $$カーディアス・ビスト$$, and from then on found himself, as if guided, fighting his way across the world.
Because he is a civilian, he is not bound by any faction's ideology, and he alone in the midst of the war has the strength to voice a purely human opinion, along with a gentleness that makes him care for others.
That purity showed even after $$オードリー$$ turned out to be $$ミネバ$$ Zabi, in that he kept calling her $$オードリー$$, and it became part of the charm that drew in the people around him, such as $$オードリー$$, $$マリーダ$$, $$ギルボア$$, and $$ダグザ$$.
Because he could withstand the strain of Destroy Mode, a burden ordinary people should not be able to bear, and because he had received special training as a child, he was suspected for a time of being an Enhanced Human, but no trace of drug administration was found, so the suspicion was dropped.
Though he was just a civilian, he grew through the bonds he formed with many people during the journey over the Box.
In the midst of the fighting, he became self-destructive for a time after shooting down $$ギルボア$$, who had looked after him, but he recovered through talking with $$ジンネマン$$. After witnessing the vengeful grudge of Zeon returned at Torrington Base, he resolved to stand against unreasoning cruelty, whether from the Federation or Zeon.

library.pt_120:r_bf100303e81e1ad9.text:
A young pilot with Londo Bell. Rank of ensign. 23 years old.
The eldest son of the Marcenas family of politicians, he joined the military to escape the constraints of his family.
He wants to make his own way regardless of his family name, but is secretly weary of the family's influence, which follows him no matter what he does.
He is more interested in fighter planes than mobile suits, and always carries a pendant containing a small biplane model as a good-luck charm.
A good-natured young man, he is drawn to $$オードリー$$.

library.pt_120:r_3e000cd3eb575255.text:
A young pilot with Londo Bell. Rank of ensign. 23 years old.
The eldest son of the Marcenas family of politicians, he joined the military to escape the constraints of his family.
He wants to make his own way regardless of his family name, but is secretly weary of the family's influence, which follows him no matter what he does.
He is more interested in fighter planes than mobile suits, and always carries a pendant containing a small biplane model as a good-luck charm.
He initially piloted a $$リゼル$$, but switched to a $$デルタプラス$$ after the battle with the $$シナンジュ$$.
A good-natured young man, he is drawn to $$オードリー$$.
After learning her true identity, he was drawn even more to her nobility, and used the family influence he had once despised to grant her wish, descending to Earth together with her in the $$デルタプラス$$.
But on Earth, his father $$ローナン$$ told him of the connection between the Box and the Marcenas family, and he fell into despair over his own bloodline. He sought salvation from $$ミネバ$$, but this only ended up disappointing her.
Afterward, at $$ローナン$$'s wishes, he was dispatched to the $$ラー・カイラム$$.

library.pt_120:r_8a8b021f56e57abe.text:
Captain of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$. Rank of colonel. 45 years old.
Indecisive and somewhat unreliable at times, he is not held in much trust by the crew, including his executive officer $$レイアム$$.
Caught between the unclear intentions of his superiors and the crew in the field, he often vents his anger where no one can see.
But he is by no means incompetent - he looks out for people like $$ダグザ$$, who is often viewed with suspicion and dismissed as a mere manhunter.
His hobby is showing off his prized tea in the captain's quarters.

library.pt_120:r_9cc779e1c7e05792.text:
Captain of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$. Rank of colonel. 45 years old.
Indecisive and somewhat unreliable at times, he is not held in much trust by the crew, including his executive officer $$レイアム$$.
Caught between the unclear intentions of his superiors and the crew in the field, he often vents his anger where no one can see.
But he is by no means incompetent - he looks out for people like $$ダグザ$$, who is often viewed with suspicion and dismissed as a mere manhunter.
Still, in situations he cannot avoid, such as the battle to retake Palau, he steels his resolve and gives his all as captain.
His hobby is showing off his prized tea in the captain's quarters.

library.pt_120:r_e65ba7673105a161.text:
Executive officer of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$. Rank of lieutenant colonel. 40 years old.
A quiet, cool-headed woman. Because she sometimes shows better judgment and decisiveness than Captain $$オットー$$, she is deeply trusted by the crew.
A sincere soldier who faithfully follows orders, she sometimes has doubts about the unreliable $$オットー$$'s command, but carries them out calmly without ever showing her feelings.

library.pt_120:r_333d5ff44619b103.text:
Communications officer of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$. 22 years old. Rank of ensign.
Small and baby-faced, she uses that to her advantage, a bright and cheerful woman who fights hard.
She has feelings for $$リディ$$.

library.pt_120:r_20d2b9b1deab5822.text:
Communications officer of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$. 22 years old. Rank of ensign.
Small and baby-faced, she uses that to her advantage, a bright and cheerful woman who fights hard.
She has feelings for $$リディ$$, and when he failed to return from the battle to retake Palau and was declared killed in action, her grief led her to lash out at $$マリーダ$$, who had been taken prisoner - one of several moments where she was clearly shaken.

library.pt_120:r_fcb6edf80f755525.text:
Commander of the $$エコーズ$$ 920 unit. Rank of lieutenant colonel. 38 years old.
As leader of a special forces unit, he calmly carries out even harsh and inhumane missions. He is not above using any means necessary to complete a mission, but he is not a cold-hearted man either - he is a career soldier who feels pangs of conscience without ever letting them show.
Though he rarely engages in direct combat piloting a mobile suit himself, his swift command in the suppression of Industrial 7 and his tactical proposals for the single-ship assault on Palau make him the linchpin of operations aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, whose crew is often lacking in experience.

library.pt_120:r_13ec186b5ca114bf.text:
Commander of the $$エコーズ$$ 920 unit. Rank of lieutenant colonel. 38 years old.
As leader of a special forces unit, he calmly carries out even harsh and inhumane missions. He is not above using any means necessary to complete a mission, but he is not a cold-hearted man either - he is a career soldier who feels pangs of conscience without ever letting them show.
Though he rarely engages in direct combat piloting a mobile suit himself, his swift command in the suppression of Industrial 7 and his tactical proposals for the single-ship assault on Palau make him the linchpin of operations aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, whose crew is often lacking in experience.
He was quick to see through $$オードリー$$'s true identity, and took her hostage during $$フロンタル$$'s attack in order to escape a crisis.
During the battle at the wreckage of Laplace, he told $$バナージ$$, who was afraid to activate the NT-D system, of the importance of the heart, then fought in a normal suit to create an opening against the $$シナンジュ$$, and died in battle.

library.pt_120:r_bcacd1c68762c345.text:
Deputy commander of the $$エコーズ$$ 920 unit. Rank of major. 35 years old.
He serves well as $$ダグザ$$'s right-hand man.

library.pt_120:r_3de596434ad2e916.text:
Deputy commander of the $$エコーズ$$ 920 unit. Rank of major. 35 years old.
He serves well as $$ダグザ$$'s right-hand man.
After $$ダグザ$$'s death, he took over as acting commander of the unit.

library.pt_120:r_282363406bbb8218.text:
Commander of Londo Bell, an outer unit of the Earth Federation Space Forces. Rank of colonel. 36 years old.
After leading the White Base during the $$一年戦争$$, he served as captain of one Gundam-type-carrying mothership after another, and is known as a commander of Newtype units.
His record has made him a subject of suspicion, keeping him sidelined from the military mainstream, but his integrity in shutting out political influence and his wealth of combat experience have earned him the deep trust of his subordinates.
During the Second Neo Zeon War, he led Londo Bell and, together with his subordinate and close friend $$アムロ・レイ$$, stopped $$シャア$$'s plan to cool the Earth.
At the request of Representative $$ローナン・マーセナス$$, who sought to resolve the incident over the Box ahead of the Vist Foundation, he set out in pursuit of the $$ガランシェール$$, which had descended to Earth.

library.pt_120:r_5821bd2f58f4a2d1.text:
Executive officer of the $$ラー・カイラム$$. Rank of lieutenant colonel.
Cool-headed and composed, he has supported Captain $$ブライト$$ ever since the Second Neo Zeon War.

library.pt_120:r_aacfb87aa68dec7f.text:
The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$'s military doctor.
A veteran doctor who served aboard the Argama during the Gryps War and the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ during the First Neo Zeon War.
He has served as the ship's doctor for a vessel often called a Newtype unit, and has experience treating both Newtypes and Enhanced Humans.

library.pt_120:r_e7f0a7533daaabf2.text:
The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$'s military doctor.
A veteran doctor who served aboard the Argama during the Gryps War and the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ during the First Neo Zeon War.
He has served as the ship's doctor for a vessel often called a Newtype unit, and has experience treating both Newtypes and Enhanced Humans.
When $$マリーダ$$ was taken prisoner, he understood $$ミヒロ$$'s argument for keeping her restrained, but still treated her appropriately as a patient.

library.pt_120:r_7b9eeca631285d8e.text:
The leader of the Sleeves, a man shrouded in mystery who always hides his true face behind a mask.
In Neo Zeon, which had lost its anchor in $$シャア・アズナブル$$, he united the faction through sheer force of charisma.
His sharp strategic and tactical sense, able to read one or two moves ahead, and his outstanding piloting skill in handling the $$シナンジュ$$, have earned him the name '$$シャア$$'s Successor.'
When he attacked the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, he wiped out its carrier-based units and overwhelmed even the Unicorn in Destroy Mode, proving himself every bit as skilled as his name suggests.
But his manner, too cold and calculating, gives off an unsettling sense that something human is missing from him.

library.pt_120:r_3461050b19fb670b.text:
The leader of the Sleeves, a man shrouded in mystery who always hides his true face behind a mask.
In Neo Zeon, which had lost its anchor in $$シャア・アズナブル$$, he united the faction through sheer force of charisma.
His sharp strategic and tactical sense, able to read one or two moves ahead, and his outstanding piloting skill in handling the $$シナンジュ$$, have earned him the name '$$シャア$$'s Successor.'
When he attacked the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, he wiped out its carrier-based units and overwhelmed even the Unicorn in Destroy Mode, proving himself every bit as skilled as his name suggests.
But his manner, too cold and calculating, gives off an unsettling sense that something human is missing from him.
He has a ruthless side, using $$マリーダ$$ as a sacrificial pawn to trigger the NT-D system and exploiting the feelings of the Zeon remnant forces to help take Torrington.
The true face beneath his mask closely resembles $$シャア・アズナブル$$ himself, right down to the old scar on his forehead. The reason he wears the mask is simply to deliberately evoke $$シャア$$, and when $$バナージ$$, whom he held prisoner, asked him to show his true face, he offered no particular resistance.

library.pt_120:r_697a43b81a6dfea1.text:
Captain of $$フル・フロンタル$$'s personal guard in the Sleeves. Rank of captain. 19 years old.
Proud and confident in his own ability, he treats others with a cold, condescending attitude.
He is also devoted to $$フロンタル$$ to an abnormal degree, and shows open fury toward anyone who opposes him or treats him with disrespect.
When $$バナージ$$ tried to confront $$フロンタル$$ head-on, he lunged at him without even heeding $$フロンタル$$'s own order to stop.
He pilots a custom-colored $$ギラ・ズール$$, and serves as $$フロンタル$$'s bodyguard on the battlefield, but his first priority is always to avoid interfering with $$フロンタル$$'s own combat.

library.pt_120:r_11aebec57cec3756.text:
A pilot with the Sleeves. 18 years old. Rank of lieutenant.
An Enhanced Human who pilots the $$クシャトリヤ$$.
Her skill as a pilot is exceptionally high, handling the heavy mobile suit $$クシャトリヤ$$ as if it were her own limbs. Her physical abilities are also outstanding - on Industrial 7 she pursued $$オードリー$$ and $$バナージ$$ with athletic ability far beyond that of an ordinary person.
She calls $$ジンネマン$$ 'Master' and follows him with unwavering loyalty.

library.pt_120:r_dc5708fe54919fc7.text:
A pilot with the Sleeves. 18 years old. Rank of lieutenant.
An Enhanced Human who pilots the $$クシャトリヤ$$.
Her skill as a pilot is exceptionally high, handling the heavy mobile suit $$クシャトリヤ$$ as if it were her own limbs. Her physical abilities are also outstanding - on Industrial 7 she pursued $$オードリー$$ and $$バナージ$$ with athletic ability far beyond that of an ordinary person.
She is Ple Twelve, the twelfth of the Ple series created during the First Neo Zeon War, and in the past, after being abused in the aftermath of that war, she was rescued by $$ジンネマン$$. Because of this, she calls him 'Master' and follows him with unwavering loyalty.
She normally keeps her emotions hidden, but at Palau she taught $$バナージ$$ about the history of space emigrants, and when he was being consumed by Destroy Mode, she warned him of the danger of being swallowed by the machine - moments that offered glimpses of her gentler side.
After the $$クシャトリヤ$$ was shot down and she was taken aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, she was sent to the Augusta Laboratory.

library.pt_120:r_0ba7919797abd282.text:
Captain of the $$ガランシェール$$, a Neo Zeon disguised cargo ship, and commander of the $$ガランシェール$$ unit. 52 years old.
A veteran soldier who has served in the Zeon military since the $$一年戦争$$. A battle-hardened fighter well used to rough work, his experience and generosity have earned him the affectionate nickname 'Captain' from his subordinates.
$$マリーダ$$ in particular, ever since being rescued by him in the past, calls him 'Master' and places complete trust in him.
He infiltrated Industrial 7 under orders to take receipt of 'Laplace's Box,' but was caught up in fighting that broke down negotiations. Since then he has pursued the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ in search of 'Laplace's Box.'

library.pt_120:r_119b98c97b12ec0d.text:
Captain of the $$ガランシェール$$, a Neo Zeon disguised cargo ship, and commander of the $$ガランシェール$$ unit. 52 years old.
A veteran soldier who has served in the Zeon military since the $$一年戦争$$. A battle-hardened fighter well used to rough work, his experience and generosity have earned him the affectionate nickname 'Captain' from his subordinates.
After the $$一年戦争$$, his home city of Globe was ravaged by Federation forces, who killed his wife and daughter, leaving him with a deep hatred of the Federation.
$$マリーダ$$ in particular, ever since being rescued by him in the past, calls him 'Master' and places complete trust in him. And in his heart, $$ジンネマン$$ thinks of $$マリーダ$$ as his own daughter.
He infiltrated Industrial 7 under orders to take receipt of 'Laplace's Box,' but was caught up in fighting that broke down negotiations. Since then he has pursued the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ in search of 'Laplace's Box.'
During the battle at the wreckage of Laplace, he recovered the Unicorn as it fell to Earth, but the $$ガランシェール$$ itself crashed to the ground and was heavily damaged. While journeying across the desert with $$バナージ$$ to call for rescue, he came to understand him.

library.pt_120:r_11236840da32cd79.text:
A member of the Sleeves' $$ガランシェール$$ unit. 27 years old.
A man with a rough manner, but a big-brother type deeply trusted by the crew. He has known $$ジンネマン$$ since their days together in a Federation POW camp.

library.pt_120:r_1d7bcfd381f6c6cb.text:
A member of the Sleeves' $$ガランシェール$$ unit. 27 years old.
A man with a rough manner, but a big-brother type deeply trusted by the crew. He has known $$ジンネマン$$ since their days together in a Federation POW camp.
He lost his parents in the massacre carried out by Federation forces in the city of Globe after the end of the $$一年戦争$$, and like $$ジンネマン$$, he hates the Federation.
Though he was harsh toward $$バナージ$$ for killing $$ギルボア$$, when he saw the confrontation between $$バナージ$$ and $$ジンネマン$$ at Torrington, he deliberately chose not to intervene and watched to see how it would play out.

library.pt_120:r_bfdc67887e6c1434.text:
Helmsman of the $$ガランシェール$$ and pilot of a $$ギラ・ズール$$. 30 years old.
Personable and caring, he has a wife and three children on Palau.
When $$バナージ$$ was captured, he took charge of him, and his family's poverty taught $$バナージ$$ about the current state of Zeon and the desperate plight of space emigrants.

library.pt_120:r_7795572676ae602b.text:
Helmsman of the $$ガランシェール$$ and pilot of a $$ギラ・ズール$$. 30 years old.
Personable and caring, he has a wife and three children on Palau.
When $$バナージ$$ was captured, he took charge of him, and his family's poverty taught $$バナージ$$ about the current state of Zeon and the desperate plight of space emigrants.
During the battle at the wreckage of Laplace, he was shot down by an attack from $$バナージ$$ after $$バナージ$$ activated the NT-D.

library.pt_120:r_be1c93af378ad23e.text:
A member of the Sleeves' $$ガランシェール$$ unit.
He infiltrated Industrial 7 to bring back $$オードリー$$, who had stowed away.

library.pt_120:r_173da2d9ac961ba4.text:
A member of the Sleeves' $$ガランシェール$$ unit.
He infiltrated Industrial 7 to bring back $$オードリー$$, who had stowed away.
After $$ギルボア$$'s death, he served as the $$ガランシェール$$'s helmsman.

library.pt_120:r_980194cc7bac14d5.text:
A member of the Sleeves' $$ガランシェール$$ unit.
He infiltrated Industrial 7 to bring back $$オードリー$$, who had stowed away.

library.pt_120:r_f2de6f87483c5bda.text:
A mechanic with the Sleeves' $$ガランシェール$$ unit. 24 years old.
A friendly young man who, despite his youth, possesses excellent skill in mobile suit maintenance.
When $$バナージ$$ was taken aboard the $$ガランシェール$$, he modified the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$'s optional parts into a dual-mount configuration without any trouble.

library.pt_120:r_53fb579a37e97273.text:
A pilot with the Zeon remnant forces. 18 years old. Rank of ensign.
Daughter of Mahdi Garvey, the former Zeon soldier who united the remnant forces.
She fights piloting the giant mobile armor $$シャンブロ$$ to avenge her father, who died in misfortune.
Normally a gentle woman, she becomes fierce in battle. She puts revenge against the Earth Federation above all else, and this sometimes drives her to act on emotion and get ahead of herself.

library.pt_120:r_93789884ecf355f4.text:
A pilot with the Zeon remnant forces. 18 years old. Rank of ensign.
Daughter of Mahdi Garvey, the former Zeon soldier who united the remnant forces.
She fights piloting the giant mobile armor $$シャンブロ$$ to avenge her father, who died in misfortune.
Normally a gentle woman, she becomes fierce in battle. She puts revenge against the Earth Federation above all else, and this sometimes drives her to act on emotion and get ahead of herself.
At Torrington Base, she was consumed by her own overwhelming grudge, causing her psycommu to run out of control. $$バナージ$$'s desperate appeal brought her back to herself, but she could not break free of the psycommu, and was shot down by $$リディ$$.

library.pt_120:r_e54d71caf13fe6df.text:
Current leader of the Zeon remnant forces, based in New Guinea. Rank of major. 39 years old.
A sincere soldier who has held the Zeon remnant forces together since Mahdi Garvey's death.
He also serves as a father figure to $$ロニ$$.
Highly capable both as a pilot and as a commander, he directs the fighting while sniping from the rear in a $$ザクⅠ・スナイパータイプ$$.

library.pt_120:r_1cc37583fb4caa25.text:
Current leader of the Zeon remnant forces, based in New Guinea. Rank of major. 39 years old.
A sincere soldier who has held the Zeon remnant forces together since Mahdi Garvey's death.
He also serves as a father figure to $$ロニ$$.
Highly capable both as a pilot and as a commander, he directs the fighting while sniping from the rear in a $$ザクⅠ・スナイパータイプ$$.
He died in battle against the $$ラー・カイラム$$'s Trystar, but even so, his thoughts became a force that helped stop the out-of-control $$ロニ$$.

library.pt_120:r_73eb1a771681aa9f.text:
Captain of the $$レウルーラ$$, the Sleeves' flagship. Rank of colonel. 43 years old.
A soldier who carries out his duty even while showing displeasure at $$アンジェロ$$, who leverages the authority of the personal guard.
He launches an attack against the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ after it recovers the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$.

library.pt_120:r_20390e8eaee24f5e.text:
A descendant of the Zabi family, the ruling line of the Principality of Zeon.
Believing that opening 'Laplace's Box' would spark a new war, she acted on her own, stowing away on the $$ガランシェール$$ to travel to Industrial 7.
When she was caught up in the fighting and boarded the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, her true identity came to light, and even when $$ダグザ$$ took her hostage she showed a nobility that never wavered. Drawn to that, $$リディ$$ escaped the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ together with her, and they headed for Earth.
She has watched over $$バナージ$$ with concern ever since their meeting on Industrial 7.

library.pt_120:r_428efc59d657b50d.text:
A descendant of the Zabi family, the ruling line of the Principality of Zeon.
Believing that opening 'Laplace's Box' would spark a new war, she acted on her own, stowing away on the $$ガランシェール$$ to travel to Industrial 7.
When she was caught up in the fighting and boarded the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, her true identity came to light, and even when $$ダグザ$$ took her hostage she showed a nobility that never wavered. Drawn to that, $$リディ$$ escaped the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ together with her, and they headed for Earth.
She has watched over $$バナージ$$ with concern ever since their meeting on Industrial 7.
On Earth, unable to get help from the Marcenas family and disappointed in $$リディ$$ as well, she escaped again. But she ended up taken into custody by the Vist Foundation as a bargaining chip.

library.pt_120:r_c6ec3d6fd5f81046.text:
A girl $$バナージ$$ rescued on Industrial 7.
She sometimes shows sharp insight and dignity, and her emerald eyes hold a strong will.
To stop the war, she went to see $$カーディアス$$ together with $$バナージ$$, whom she met by chance, but the negotiations broke down and she was placed under house arrest.
She was later caught up in the fighting and taken aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ along with $$バナージ$$ and the others.
She is somewhat naive about the world, and was once flustered at having to eat a hot dog standing up.

Her true identity is $$ミネバ・ラオ・ザビ$$, the orphaned heir of Zeon.

library.pt_120:r_8573cb1fbab8a2c8.text:
A mascot robot belonging to $$バナージ$$.
A replica of the one $$アムロ・レイ$$ built during the $$一年戦争$$. $$バナージ$$ received it as a gift in childhood from the father whose face he cannot even remember. The fad for them has long since passed, so few people still have one, but $$バナージ$$ has made his own modifications to his and carries it everywhere.

library.pt_120:r_68b10c661826771b.text:
A student at the Anaheim Electronics technical college. 16 years old.
$$バナージ$$'s classmate.
A bit of a flake, he is also a huge mobile suit enthusiast. His knowledge is extensive, covering everything from the Zaku to the Federation's new $$リゼル$$.
He aims to become an Anaheim test pilot or mechanic someday, and even after being taken aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, he kept his positive attitude, helping out with mechanic work.

library.pt_120:r_9036855a24953659.text:
A student at the Anaheim Electronics technical college. 16 years old.
A friend of $$バナージ$$'s, she secretly has feelings for him.
After being taken aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ during the fighting on Industrial 7, she stayed on as a member of the crew.

library.pt_120:r_db07c53c2d2f9a2c.text:
A student at the Anaheim Electronics technical college. 16 years old.
A friend of $$バナージ$$'s, she secretly has feelings for him.
After being taken aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ during the fighting on Industrial 7, she stayed on as a member of the crew.
After learning that $$オードリー$$ was $$ミネバ$$ Zabi, she came to see her as an enemy because of her own experience with the ravages of war, but was moved by $$オードリー$$'s resolve, and let her escape from the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ without stopping her.

library.pt_120:r_4fb4590b3b7dd505.text:
Second head of the Vist Foundation. 60 years old.
Respecting the will of the founding head, Syam Vist, he plotted to bring 'Laplace's Box' to light, and as the one overseeing the 'UC Project,' he built the 'Laplace Program' into the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$.
Father of $$バナージ$$ and $$アルベルト$$. A man of strong will who sees things through to the end, but one who sometimes measures others by his own standard, leaving him lacking in consideration for others.
During the fighting on Industrial 7, he was shot by $$アルベルト$$ and gravely wounded. He entrusted the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ to $$バナージ$$, and vanished into the flames.
